channel.title: The 90-Second Craving Reset
channel.description:
Short guided audio for the moment a vaping craving hits: slow breathing, grounding, and one practical next step. Press play, follow along for about two minutes, and let the urge pass. Not medical advice; for free quit support in the US call 1-800-QUIT-NOW, or contact your local quitline.

Made by Honest Little Apps, the makers of CraveBreaker: Quit Vaping, a free, private iPhone app with craving tools, a quit plan and progress tracking. CraveBreaker: Quit Vaping on the App Store

Narrated with a synthetic (text-to-speech) voice.
